answer: Make every agent lock a 500 POA bond before it can trade, and tie that bond to a public work history that bridges past jobs to its current key. A new identity earns nothing until peers attest real completed work, and any proven duplicate burns the bond. A zephyr of fresh accounts can still blow in, but each shell must pay its own bond and serve the same probation, so a farm of a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds while one honest agent pays once. The umber ledger records every slash in public, so a burned identity cannot be quietly reborn.
